metadata.timing_boundary: Preconverted Value rows, row IDs, metadata and shared page scaffolding outside timing. Combined includes argument construction, value encoding and byte estimation. V1 per-slice field boxing inside combined/construction. Sizing uses identical prebuilt command pages. Network/TLS/Redis, Arrow conversion, source/ownership preflight, hooks, publication and native/RSS excluded.
metadata.validation: Every complete argument page and established byte count compared before and after timing; all336 observations passed.
metadata.shape_rule: Dense, half-NULL target,95%-NULL target and one-non-NULL-field shapes. Last public field always non-NULL so all rows obey source INSERT nonempty-HASH rule; percentages are target rather than exact for narrow fixtures. Explicit source key remains non-NULL.
metadata.phase_interpretation: Independent phase benchmarks; their medians must not be added/subtracted as exclusive server or native wall-time attribution. Construction is an exact test-only copy of unchanged production loop; sizing-only uses actual production estimator.
metadata.ordering: Fixed case/variant order and three observations per case; not randomized crossover or confidence intervals. Parent serialized other heavy work; shared workstation may have unrelated activity.
